prospective_protocol: Before looking at reserved late values, lock the candidate model, training set, target and feature availability rules.
Screen full source-family overlap, device/chemistry/protocol and digitizable early window independently of performance; keep exclusions and ambiguous cases.
Separate early-input extraction from the author endpoint table, preserve access/exposure records and freeze predictions before unsealing labels.
If results appear during screening, record exposure; do not use that candidate as evidence of a blinded assessment. No tuning based on this final set.
